scope: SOURCE VALIDATION SOCIAL DISTRIBUTION AUDIT ONLY
attention_definition: original SDPA identity-value probe using unchanged MHA packed projections and padding mask; mean of four per-head softmax weights; renormalize valid neighbors; no dropout in eval

attention_context_reproduction_tolerance.reason: independently reconstruct unchanged original SDPA context; prediction forward remains unchanged

saved_response_reproduction_tolerance.reason: float32 forward versus previous GPU-resident cache; saved ADE/FDE, mean residual and correction ratio remain authoritative

closing_definition: mean_closing_speed aliases mean_positive_closing_speed, mean over strictly approaching valid neighbors, or 0; max_closing_speed=max(0,max signed closing); signed mean/max also saved
zero_neighbor_definition: distance/relative-speed are missing NaN with count=0; closing/attention statistics are 0
distance_bins: no neighbor; <2m; [2m,4m); [4m,8m]; >8m, based on nearest distance
motion_quartiles: pooled unique observation windows; <=q25, (q25,q50], (q50,q75], >q75; tied cutoffs may yield empty groups
primary_aggregation: unique observation-window mean response over available fold/seed checkpoints, then scene equal weight
correlation_definition: weighted Pearson; weighted Spearman via weighted empirical mid-CDF ranks; no p-values
label_interpretation: prespecified descriptive bins only, not significance tests, causal proof, or model hyperparameters
